markets.title: Will Flávio Bolsonaro win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
markets.edge: 次輪政治流動最大腿；Yes~80% 與 Lula 對偶，流動性兩邊都深，當巴西盤錨點而非盲目追漲。
markets.trap: 真實結算＝大選最終結果（含次輪）；規則硬截止 2027-06-30 23:59 ET。gamma endDate 2026-10-05 已過期且錯誤，勿當截止。
markets.note: 24h vol ~$1,526,400; liq ~$814,501；resolvesAt=規則硬截止（若結果未明→Other）；gamma endDate 2026-10-05 錯誤已棄用
markets.resolutionMethod: Resolves to listed candidate that wins 2026 Brazilian presidential election (includes second round). Source: consensus of credible reporting.

markets.title: Will Harry Kane win the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
markets.edge: Kane 仍是定價錨(~70%)；相對 Mbappé/Yamal 結構，主要風險是敘事切換而非流動性。
markets.trap: 多結果市場，邊加總≠1 時有套利/摩擦；留意獎項規則與賽季截止。 gamma endDate≈10/27 非頒獎日；規則硬截止為 2026-12-31 23:59 ET（未頒→Other）。
markets.note: 24h vol ~$449,881; liq ~$141,683；resolvesAt=規則硬截止（未頒獎→Other）；gamma endDate≈10/27 不可當頒獎日已棄用
markets.resolutionMethod: Resolves to winner of the 2026 Ballon d'Or; if none declared by market end → No.

markets.title: Will Kylian Mbappé win the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
markets.edge: 價~17% 已高於 Yamal~13%，24h 量常是 Ballon 腿最大；X 粉絲敘事分裂＝波動源，適合相對價值而非單邊信仰。
markets.trap: 熱度≠得獎概率；別用社群聲量直接當 fair value。 gamma endDate≈10/27 非頒獎日；規則硬截止為 2026-12-31 23:59 ET（未頒→Other）。
markets.note: price=mid of bestBid 0.166 / bestAsk 0.171（gamma）；24h vol ~$915,142; liq ~$196,094；resolvesAt=規則硬截止（未頒獎→Other）；gamma endDate≈10/27 不可當頒獎日已棄用
markets.resolutionMethod: Resolves to winner of the 2026 Ballon d'Or; if none declared by market end → No.

markets.title: Will Lamine Yamal win the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
markets.edge: 與 Mbappé 同事件相對價值腿：敘事熱但定價更低；做相對而非單押。

markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
markets.edge: Hold ~95.5% 是宏觀定價核心；升息 25bps 腿僅~4.5%。倉位服務校準，不是賭驚喜。
markets.trap: 「meeting」決議口徑與未來指引不同；別把發言當成加息。
markets.resolutionMethod: Resolves on upper bound of target federal funds range after the Oct 2026 FOMC meeting (0 bps change = Yes).

markets.title: 2026 Balance of Power: D Senate, D House
markets.edge: BoP 四格盤流動極深；D+D ~66.5% 是中期結構錨。用四格聯合概率校準，勿只看單一國會盤。
markets.trap: 四結果互斥；加總偏離 1 時先查是否同一 event 時間戳。
markets.resolutionMethod: Resolves to party controlling US Senate AND party controlling US House after 2026 midterms (D Senate + D House).

markets.title: Will the U.S. invade Iran before 2027?
markets.edge: ~19.5% 定的是「軍事進攻以建立控制」口徑；常被跟短到期停火／空襲盤混談，規則不對稱才是資訊差。
markets.trap: 要建立控制意圖的進攻才算 Yes；空襲本身不夠。
markets.resolutionMethod: Yes if US commences military offensive intended to establish control over any portion of Iran by 2026-12-31 23:59 ET; airstrikes alone insufficient. Source: consensus of credible reporting.

markets.title: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the October 2026 meeting?
markets.edge: 左尾保險定價~4.5%；只在你對 hold 校準明顯偏高、或要對沖意外 hawkish 時才有 EV。
markets.trap: 低價≠免費；多數時間歸零。倉位上限要硬。
markets.resolutionMethod: Resolves on upper bound of target federal funds range after the Oct 2026 FOMC meeting (+25 bps = Yes).
